messages:
susan_parks: Quick heads-up: GovCloud marketplace listing requires fresh SOC2 report + SI-witnessed pen test. Need a secure artifact flow for evidence handoff. Who can own redaction + manifest?

luke_ops: I'll take presign lifecycle and S3 retention. Will add a sample presign script (lambda helper) and bucket policy.

anita_security: I'll draft redaction checklist. SI wants presigned links + CloudTrail proof. Recommend TTL=72h. Also we need signed bundles (PGP) and SHA256 checksums. :white_check_mark:

susan_parks: FYI partner questionnaire needs a new Q about redaction scope. @jenna_int can you update?

jenna_int: Yep. Proposed answer options: Full redact, mapping doc, scoped reveal with expiring creds. My vote: redact + mapping CSV. Example mapping line: `original_value,redaction_token,reason` e.g., `i-0abcd1234,REDACTED:instance,prod-instance`

raj_k: SI asks for remote witness via screen-share + artifact pull. On-site only if blocker. We'll provide PGP fingerprint over 1:1. Proposed pen window: May 10-14.

anita_security: Checklist items I'll include:
- presign TTL = 72h
- CloudTrail export to evidence bucket
- bundle zip signed (PGP) + SHA256 file
- redaction manifest CSV attached
- reviewer rotation and timestamps
I'll drop template today.

luke_ops: Sample presign snippet I'll push to Git (internal) and send here. Also will set lifecycle rule: keep raw artifacts 30d, redacted bundles 365d.

susan_parks: Owners:
- anita_security: redaction checklist + manifest template (Due Thu)
- luke_ops: presign script + lifecycle policy (Due Wed)
- raj_k: confirm SI witness schedule + exchange PGP (Due Fri)
- jenna_int: partner questionnaire update (Due Thu)
If anyone needs a quick sync, ping me and we'll set 30m. Thanks! :pray:

calendar-bot: Meeting created: "GovCloud listing: evidence & pen prep" Wed 10:00 AM PT. Invite: https://calendar.company.internal/meet/xyz123
